Skill required: Insurance Services - Business Intelligence (BI) Reporting Tools

Designation: Measurement & Report Senior Analyst

Qualifications:Any Graduation

Years of Experience:5 to 8 years

About Accenture

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com

What would you do? As a part of client reporting and insights, you would need to do Power Bi based Reporting for different Operational Purposes. MIS reporting by using MS Excel and VBA (macro) at Operational. Ad hoc automation for different Operational requirements. Creating and modifying SQL queries as per requirements based on client and operational use. Performance reporting Data and Trend Analysis to correlate process performance. Supporting Operations team in different types of data analysis with the help of SQL and Power Bi. Creating salesforce reports for client and operational uses. Drive performance improvements through automation. Perform data analysis for generating reports on periodic basis. Analyze business information to identify process improvements for increasing business efficiency and effectiveness. Participate in cross functional meetings to resolve recurring customer issues. Business Intelligence (BI) Reporting refers to the process of collecting, processing, & presenting business data to help organizations make informed decisions. It involves using software & tools to transform raw data into meaningful insights through reports, dashboards, & visualizations.

What are we looking for?

• Ability to establish strong client relationship
• Ability to handle disputes
• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders
• Ability to meet deadlines
• Ability to perform under pressure MS Office and Power Bi Roles and Responsibilities:
• In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of increasingly complex problems
• Your day to day interactions are with peers within Accenture
• You are likely to have some interaction with clients and/or Accenture management
• You will be given minimal instruction on daily work/tasks and a moderate level of instruction on new assignments
• Decisions that are made by you impact your own work and may impact the work of others
• In this role you would be an individual contributor and/or oversee a small work effort and/or team
• Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

About the team:

  • The CPQ & NPI Operations team sits within Product Operations and is at the core of how we bring new products to market and optimise our quote-to-cash process. We don’t just operationalise new SKUs—we ensure seamless integration of next-generation quoting tools, drive automation, and enhance the overall sales experience. We partner across Product, Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance to streamline how products are configured, quoted, sold, and provisioned. Our team ensures that our CPQ and Product Master tools remain high-performing, scalable systems—balancing automation, policy enforcement, and ease of use without overloading it with unnecessary complexity.

About the role:

  • We are seeking a highly driven, enterprising individual with exceptional communication skills to join our NPI Operations team and help operationalise our products in our quote-to-cash processes. In this full-time hybrid role, you’ll use your NPI and CPQ knowledge to translate strategy into operational reality: aligning with cross-functional partners on process and policy, compiling requirements, and delivering efficient, scalable solutions from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End of Life (EOL).

What you'll do:

  • Support GTM initiatives and new product launches; be accountable for CPQ and NPI deliverables that drive product growth and improve sales productivity.
  • Own the NPI Operations ticket queue and dashboards: triage, assign, track, and follow up to meet SLAs and prevent escalations; balance day-to-day support with small to medium projects.
  • Regularly compile reports and provide clear status updates; communicate timelines, risks, and decisions to stakeholders.
  • Deliver NPI releases and bug fixes based on priority; execute predefined processes independently and escalate for support or visibility when appropriate.
  • Lead CPQ and NPI enhancements and initiatives end-to-end: requirements analysis, consensus-building, solution design, testing, documentation, training, and launch.
  • Partner closely with IT and cross-functional teams to design scalable, agile solutions and drive timely delivery through effective coordination and communication.
  • Maintain the product master and ensure SKU configuration integrity across PDM and CPQ environments; recommend improvements grounded in best practices.
  • Analyse and optimise CPQ and NPI processes to drive efficiency and scalability; assess upstream/downstream impacts across PDM, CPQ, billing, and renewals.
  • Work across the full quote-to-cash lifecycle—from packaging, pricing, and selling to growth, retention, and EOL transitions—to drive cross-functional alignment.
  • Create, maintain, and deliver training and documentation for all new implementations to drive adoption and ensure stakeholders are enabled as products and processes roll out.
  • Mentor junior analysts on CPQ/NPI processes and best practices.

Experience you'll need:

  • Required:
    • 8+ years in a Business Analyst or operations role, preferably in a SaaS environment
    • 6+ years of hands-on experience in CPQ or other quote-to-cash system
    • Track record contributing to go-to-market initiatives in high-growth, scaling organisations; proven ability to translate strategy into executable plans
    • Self-starter & Results-Driven: demonstrates a high level of productivity with minimal oversight; takes ownership, shows initiative, and proactively drives solutions to completion
    • Strategic thinker: evaluate things holistically and for the long term, make decisions using a strong blend of technical chops, risk assessment, and understanding of business needs and priorities
    • Excellent communication and follow-up skills; transparency, and the ability to synthesise information into a clear, digestible format for business operations teams
    • Adept collaboration skills; Comfort working cross-functionally and learning new domains quickly; technical fluency in systems and data concepts; ability to influence without formal authority
    • Strong analytical skills; able to assess CPQ and downstream impacts, analyse data to identify issues, and recommend solutions.
    • Hands-on experience with operational tools and systems (e.g., Salesforce, Jira); familiarity with quoting, SKU configuration, and the product development lifecycle.
    • High-energy, company first, positive attitude: Passionate and motivated to make a massive impact and work hard in a fast-paced environment
    • You are detail-oriented, leverage your resources, and get things done on time with quality results
  • Preferred:
    • Experience delivering NPI releases, complex SKU updates, and changes that span multiple workstreams.
    • SFDC administration experience and/or Salesforce certifications.
    • Familiarity with AI concepts, ideally as applied to the Sales function, is a plus.

Working Hours: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST.

  • Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
